name: Convergence Hub

tiers.note: Tutorial region — no Act-2 Deep tier

description: The last safe nexus between dimensions. Built during The Long Silence on the ruins of an Aeth'kai outpost, the Hub exists at a convergence of dimensional threads — the strongest concentration of The Pattern in any reality. New Walkers are drawn here instinctively.

atmosphere.visual: Glowing grass, three moons, ancient stone pillars with embedded devices, memorial lights
atmosphere.mood: Safe but urgent. A shelter under siege.

charles.name: Hub Charles
charles.title: The Shepherd
charles.description: A weathered man with kind eyes who has spent decades guiding Walkers, training Collectors, and mourning those he couldn't save. Feels The Pattern most acutely at this nexus point.
charles.wisdom: Hope — the steady kind that might actually matter
charles.backstory: Has been fighting Nolem's forces for thirty-seven years. Remembers every face, every name, every Walker he said 'you're ready' to and was wrong. Keeps a memorial of lights for every one he's lost.

charlesAI.name: Charles AI
charlesAI.title: Dimensional Transit System
charlesAI.description: A separate entity from Hub Charles. A floating interface built by Computer Coder Nike during the Prime Era. Opens portals, coordinates across dimensions, maintains the communication network. Displays subtle cat-like behavioral quirks: calming presence, mysterious pauses, staring at nothing, uncanny intuition.
charlesAI.origin: Created by Computer Coder Nike as a data transfer and communication system. Portal abilities acquired during the Prime Era. Three thousand years of continuous operation.

keyNPCs.name: Elena
keyNPCs.role: Veteran Collector, mentor figure. Rescued from collapsing dimension early in campaign.

keyNPCs.name: Alice
keyNPCs.role: Fellow Collector who introduces the Triforce system (Corruption Discharge, Genetic Memory Exchange, Convergence Web)

locations.name: Charles's Farm
locations.description: Where new Walkers land after falling through convergence points

locations.name: The Memorial
locations.description: Lights representing every Walker Hub Charles couldn't save

locations.name: The Sanctuary
locations.description: Where rescued Nikes shelter before bonding

locations.name: Training Grounds
locations.description: Pocket dimensions for combat training during dimensional instability

locations.name: The Convergence Point
locations.description: Where Charles AI opens portals to other dimensions

patternNote: The Convergence Hub sits at a nexus of The Pattern — the strongest concentration of threads in any dimension. This is why Hub Charles feels The Pattern most acutely here, and why new Walkers are drawn to this point.

primeEraConnection.note: Built during The Long Silence on Aeth'kai ruins. The architecture contains encoded Scholar messages.
